deathreplay.name: Death Replay
deathreplay.message.respawn_hint: Press [%s] to watch the replay of your death.
deathreplay.options.title: Death Replay Settings
deathreplay.options.buffer_seconds.toolt: How many seconds before your death are kept for the replay. Longer uses more memory.
deathreplay.options.auto_save.tooltip: Write every death replay to the deathreplay folder in your game directory, so it can still be watched after restarting the game. A file is typically a few hundred KB to a few MB. When off, use the Save Replay button on the death screen.
deathreplay.options.replay_view.tooltip: The view a replay opens with. You can still switch while it plays.
deathreplay.options.respawn_hint.tooltip: After you respawn, show a chat line saying which key plays the replay of your death.
deathreplay.options.death_free_camera.to: Move the camera off your corpse on the death screen and add the Look Around button. Off: the death screen looks like vanilla.
deathreplay.options.death_camera_mode.to: The view the death screen opens with.
deathreplay.browser.title: Death Replays
deathreplay.browser.empty: No saved replays yet. Use Save Replay on the death screen, or turn on auto-save.
deathreplay.browser.need_world: Join a world to play a replay.
deathreplay.browser.unreadable: Could not read %s (saved by another version, or damaged)
deathreplay.browser.cannot_play: This replay cannot be played right now
deathreplay.message.save_failed: Could not save the death replay (see the log)
deathreplay.replay.title: Death Replay
deathreplay.replay.hint.first_person: Seeing what you saw   [%s] switch view   Drag the bar to seek
deathreplay.replay.hint.third_person: Hold right mouse button: turn   Scroll: distance   [%s] switch view
deathreplay.replay.hint.free: Hold right mouse button: look   Move keys: fly   Scroll: speed   [%s] switch view
deathreplay.spectate.title: Death Camera
deathreplay.spectate.hint: [%s] switch view   [Esc] back to death screen
deathreplay.spectate.hint.free: Mouse: look   Move keys: fly   Jump / Sneak: up / down
deathreplay.spectate.hint.free2: Sprint: faster   Scroll: speed   Right click: mark this spot
deathreplay.waypoint.name: Marker %s
deathreplay.waypoints.title: Markers
deathreplay.waypoints.empty: No markers. Right-click in the free camera to mark a spot.
deathreplay.waypoints.need_world: Join a world to see its markers.
deathreplay.replay.hint.mark: Right click: mark the spot under the cursor
